dialogues.jp:
「じゃあカレーかラーメン、そば、うどんあた
　りだな」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, then we can order curried rice, ramen, soba noodles
or udon noodles."
dialogues.text:
"Okay, then we can order curried rice, ramen, soba noodles
or udon noodles."

dialogues.jp:
あんまりにも無難な選択だが、味の保証がない
ので突飛なことも出来ない。
dialogues.en:
I know they are obviously a safe selection, but I don't want
to take a chance on a dish which has no guarantee of the
taste.
dialogues.text:
I know they are obviously a safe selection, but I don't want
to take a chance on a dish which has no guarantee of the
taste.

dialogues.jp:
なにを考えているのか、ここの券売機は下のほ
うに、値段のみで名称不明のボタンが生きてい
るのだが……。
dialogues.en:
I don't know why there are buttons which only have the price
and don't say what you get.
dialogues.text:
I don't know why there are buttons which only have the price
and don't say what you get.

dialogues.jp: 「そうだ。再会の祝いに今日は｛おご／奢｝るぞ」
dialogues.en: "Oh yeah. This is my treat for our reunion."
dialogues.text: "Oh yeah. This is my treat for our reunion."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ホント！　だから大好きだよお兄ちゃん♪」
dialogues.en: "Really? I love you, oniichan!"
dialogues.text: "Really? I love you, oniichan!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「――こらっ、人前で抱きついてくるな！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, don't hug me in front of people!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, don't hug me in front of people!"

dialogues.jp:
小銭を確認しようとした隙に、また腰に抱きつ
かれる。
dialogues.en: As I check the cash, she suddenly comes to cuddle again.
dialogues.text: As I check the cash, she suddenly comes to cuddle again.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「えへへへ♪　ボディーランゲージは愛情表現
　の基本だよっ……本当は応用したいんだけど
　ね」
dialogues.en:
"Teehee... Body language is the basic means of expressing
love. I wish I could apply it more."
dialogues.text:
"Teehee... Body language is the basic means of expressing
love. I wish I could apply it more."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お、応用？」
dialogues.en: "A-apply?"
dialogues.text: "A-apply?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さすがに、ね……またのお楽しみに♪」
dialogues.en: "That'll be some fun for another time."
dialogues.text: "That'll be some fun for another time."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それこそ、人前だと恥ずかしいからね」
dialogues.en: "It'd definitely be really embarrassing to do in public."
dialogues.text: "It'd definitely be really embarrassing to do in public."

dialogues.jp:
素直に腰から離れると、さくらは自分の唇に指
をあてて、意味深な笑みで俺を見上げる。
dialogues.en:
She pulls away from my waist, places her finger on her lips
and gazes up at me with a mysterious smile.
dialogues.text:
She pulls away from my waist, places her finger on her lips
and gazes up at me with a mysterious smile.

dialogues.jp: 「……なにがだ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「知りたい？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to know?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to know?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なかなか難しい問題だな」
dialogues.en: "It sounds very difficult."
dialogues.text: "It sounds very difficult."

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく雰囲気を察するに、どれほどの犠牲
を払って得るべき出来事かが問題な気がする。
dialogues.en:
I can guess what she's talking about, but the problem is how
much of a sacrifice I have to give for that.
dialogues.text:
I can guess what she's talking about, but the problem is how
much of a sacrifice I have to give for that.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「また今度、じっくりとね……料理はお任せっ。
　ボクは席をとってくる〜」
dialogues.en:
"Well, let's talk about it next time, okay? Please order
lunch for me. I'll get us some seats."
dialogues.text:
"Well, let's talk about it next time, okay? Please order
lunch for me. I'll get us some seats."

dialogues.jp:
少し前の雰囲気が嘘のように、いつもの地に足
がついていない浮ついた足取りで、さくらが机
の間を走っていく。
dialogues.en:
In a completely different mood from just a few moments ago,
Sakura runs away between the tables in flyaway steps.
dialogues.text:
In a completely different mood from just a few moments ago,
Sakura runs away between the tables in flyaway steps.

dialogues.jp:
「そうか、そういうところで暮らしてたんだな
　アイツ……」
dialogues.en: "I see. This is how she led her life over there."
dialogues.text: "I see. This is how she led her life over there."

dialogues.jp: 惜しかったような、助かったような。
dialogues.en: It was close, but also I feel I got out of trouble.
dialogues.text: It was close, but also I feel I got out of trouble.

dialogues.jp:
「｛さすが／流石｝さくらんぼ……見た目だけで舐めてかか
　ると大変だったよな」
dialogues.en:
"Rambling Sakuranbo... I could get in lots of trouble if I
just judge her by her appearance."
dialogues.text:
"Rambling Sakuranbo... I could get in lots of trouble if I
just judge her by her appearance."

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく、騒動ばかり起こしていた昔を思い
出して笑みがこぼれた。
dialogues.en:
I feel like smiling, remembering the old days with lots of
muss and fuss.
dialogues.text:
I feel like smiling, remembering the old days with lots of
muss and fuss.

dialogues.jp: 「くわばらくわばら……」
dialogues.en: "Knock on wood..."
dialogues.text: "Knock on wood..."

dialogues.jp:
俺はチキンカレーの券を２枚買って、食堂のお
ばちゃんに何気なく笑いかけた。
dialogues.en:
I buy two food tickets for chicken curried rice, flashing a
grin to the old gals working at the dining hall.
dialogues.text:
I buy two food tickets for chicken curried rice, flashing a
grin to the old gals working at the dining hall.

dialogues.jp: 「少しだけ世間話をしましょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Can I chat to you a little?"
dialogues.text: "Can I chat to you a little?"

dialogues.jp: ◆たじたじ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Very embarrassing◆
dialogues.text: ◆Very embarrassing◆

dialogues.jp:
無難に食券を買った俺は、とりあえず、それを
さくらへの再会のお祝いにすることにした。
dialogues.en:
I bought some sensible food tickets, and then I decided to
make it a reunion gift.
dialogues.text:
I bought some sensible food tickets, and then I decided to
make it a reunion gift.

dialogues.jp:
と、たったそれだけのことなのに、本気で喜び
人前で抱きついてくるさくらに、たじたじにさ
れてしまったのだ。
dialogues.en:
That was all, but Sakura was really happy with what I did,
hugging me in front of people, which embarrassed me greatly.
dialogues.text:
That was all, but Sakura was really happy with what I did,
hugging me in front of people, which embarrassed me greatly.
